note: example_advanced_datalayer provides concrete @AdvancedDatalayerTag / @AdvancedDatalayerGroup plugins for the base advanced_datalayer module (which ships none). Groups: site_Information, page_Information (+ core root). Tags: event (root); site_Name, site_Category, ga_client_id (site_Information); page_Name, page_Category, response_Code (page_Information). Tag runtime values come from advanced_datalayer_defaults config (tags map per context), not the plugin class. It also attaches js/example_advanced_datalayer.js in hook_page_attachments for client-side values. Medium cases introspect a tag's group via plugin.manager.advanced_datalayer.tag and read a value assigned to an example tag; hard cases assign example-tag values to page contexts, verified against advanced_datalayer_defaults config.

evals.prompt: The base Drupal 'advanced_datalayer' module ships no dataLayer tags. Which submodule provides a ready-made set of example tags, and name a few of the tag ids it defines.
evals.expected_output: example_advanced_datalayer provides them: tags event, site_Name, site_Category, ga_client_id, page_Name, page_Category, response_Code (grouped under root, site_Information, page_Information).

evals.prompt: What dataLayer groups does the example_advanced_datalayer submodule define to organize its tags?
evals.expected_output: It defines two @AdvancedDatalayerGroup plugins: site_Information (Site Information Group) and page_Information (Page Information Group). The core 'root' group comes from the base module.

evals.prompt: The example_advanced_datalayer module implements hook_page_attachments. What does it attach, and why?
evals.expected_output: It attaches js/example_advanced_datalayer.js (when global datalayer tags exist on a supported route) so that values which can only be computed in the browser — e.g. device type, GA client id — can be added to the dataLayer client-side.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, inspect the registered Advanced Datalayer tag plugins and report which datalayer group the 'ga_client_id' tag belongs to.
evals.expected_output: ga_client_id belongs to the site_Information group (from the tag plugin definition; e.g. \Drupal::service('plugin.manager.advanced_datalayer.tag')->getDefinition('ga_client_id')['group']).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, a value has been configured for the example 'page_Category' dataLayer tag on node pages. Inspect the live node page-variable configuration and report the value set for page_Category.
On this Drupal site, using the example Advanced Datalayer tags, configure node pages so that the 'site_Category' dataLayer tag has the value 'news'. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: advanced_datalayer.advanced_datalayer_defaults.node -> tags.site_Category = 'news' (load the 'node' advanced_datalayer_defaults entity, set tags.site_Category = 'news', save).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, configure the front page so the example 'page_Category' dataLayer tag has the value 'landing'. Apply the change to the live site.
